usageNotes: Use this to modify an existing authentication realm's settings (LDAP/AD server addresses, bind credentials, OpenID client config, sync behavior, etc.) without recreating it. The realm must already exist — use POST /access/domains to create it. Requires the Realm.Allocate privilege on /access/realm; use the 'digest' param to guard against concurrent modifications.

examples.summary: Update an AD/LDAP realm to add a fallback server and enforce LDAPS with TLS 1.2

params.comment: Primary AD realm — dual DC, LDAPS enforced

tips: The 'delete' param accepts a comma-separated list of setting keys (pve-configid-list format) to unset/reset to defaults — useful for removing stale bind passwords or obsolete filters.
Avoid setting 'secure: true'; it is deprecated. Use 'mode: ldaps' or 'mode: ldap+starttls' instead.
Setting 'default: true' on a realm makes it the pre-selected realm on the PVE login screen — only one realm can be default at a time.
LDAP bind passwords are stored in /etc/pve/priv/realm/<REALM>.pw on the cluster; this is a protected path only accessible to root.
For OpenID realms, 'autocreate' must be enabled if users logging in for the first time should be provisioned automatically; otherwise they must be pre-created in PVE.
Use 'check-connection: true' to validate the LDAP bind during the API call itself — useful for confirming connectivity before saving.
